question: Which of the following books was written by the Roman writer Pliny the elder in 77 AD, who wrote in this book that Rome was wasting its gold reserves by trading with India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Natural History.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• **Natural History**__ was written by the __**Roman writer Pliny**__ the elder in __**77 AD**__, who wrote in this book that __**Rome**__ was wasting its gold reserves by trading with India.

 
 
• **Pliny **the **Elder **wrote a book titled** "The Natural History", **often known as **Naturalis historia.**<
